newsitem.title: JAPAN: DKB group firms to brief media on merger 0900 GMT.
newsitem.headline: DKB group firms to brief media on merger 0900 GMT.

text.p: Three investment management companies in the Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) group said on Tuesday that they would hold a news conference on the issue of a merger at 6 p.m. (0900 GMT).

The presidents of the three companies -- Asahi Investment Trust Management Co, Kankaku Capital Management Co and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Investment Management Co -- are expected to attend the news conference, they said.
"We are aiming to merge and will set up a group to negotiate details of the merger," said a spokesman for Asahi Investment Trust Management.
"We are considering a merger on October 1 as one possibility," said Hiroshi Ote, president of Kankaku Capital Management.
Kankaku Capital and Asahi Investment are affiliates of Kankaku Securities Co Ltd, which is also part of the Dai-Ichi Kangyo group.
The combined managed assets of the three firms are estimated at 2.5 trillion yen, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Tuesday.
Asahi Investment mainly targets individuals, while the other two firms manage assets for pension funds and other institutional investors, the paper said.
